headline_seed: 'We will never, ever forget,' Trump says as US marks 25th anniversary of 9/11 - BBC
draft_text:
The United States marked 25 years since September 11, 2001 today.
Ceremonies in New York and Shanksville honored nearly 3,000 killed.
NBC News covered the ground zero ceremony; BBC News filed from the World Trade Center site.

And that's the mews.
